items.title: Mochi & Matcha Fest
items.venue: Japanese Cultural Center of Hawaii (first floor courtyard and breezeway)
items.price: Free admission; drinks priced by each vendor
items.description: JCCH hosts its first Mochi & Matcha Fest: mochitsuki (mochi pounding) alongside modern mochi products and matcha drinks. Vendors include Green Times Matcha and Aloha Matcha Hawaii, plus Fujiya Hawaii, Mochiffle, Sip Cafe and others.
items.notes: Date, time, venue and street address on the public AllEvents page and JCCH calendar. Same event as the existing map entry 6e4abd99b485 (Fujiya Hawaii, unsure, no address): this item adds the address and names Green Times Matcha and Aloha Matcha Hawaii as vendors. The page does not say which vendors serve matcha; both matcha-named vendors are on the list. Lat/lng approximate.
